Global Network

One Global Network. Many Local Markets.

From its Malaysian headquarters, IQI has grown into an international real estate network spanning more than 35 countries. Its model combines global reach with on-the-ground market knowledge, helping customers and partners navigate property opportunities across borders.

Millerz Square, Kuala Lumpur

IQI's headquarters team, pictured at the new HQ opening in 2024.

2011

IQI established its presence in Dubai.

2013

IQI Malaysia began operations.

2020

Juwai.com and IQI combined to form Juwai IQI.

2024

IQI opened its new headquarters at Millerz Square, Kuala Lumpur.
